import unittest

from solution import TemplateCatalog


class TemplateCatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_instances_have_independent_mappings(self):
        first = TemplateCatalog()
        second = TemplateCatalog()
        first.put("only-first", 1)
        self.assertEqual(first.get("only-first"), 1)
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            second.get("only-first")

        initialized = TemplateCatalog({"seed": 2})
        fresh = TemplateCatalog()
        self.assertEqual(initialized.snapshot(), {"seed": 2})
        self.assertEqual(fresh.snapshot(), {})

    def test_constructor_deep_copies_values_and_mapping(self):
        value = {"items": [1, {"deep": 2}]}
        initial = {"template": value}
        catalog = TemplateCatalog(initial)
        value["items"][1]["deep"] = 99
        initial["new"] = 3
        self.assertEqual(catalog.snapshot(), {"template": {"items": [1, {"deep": 2}]}})

    def test_put_returns_none_and_deep_copies(self):
        catalog = TemplateCatalog()
        value = [{"x": 1}]
        self.assertIsNone(catalog.put("name", value))
        value[0]["x"] = 9
        value.append({"x": 2})
        self.assertEqual(catalog.get("name"), [{"x": 1}])

    def test_get_and_snapshot_return_deep_copies(self):
        catalog = TemplateCatalog({"name": {"nested": [1, 2]}})
        obtained = catalog.get("name")
        obtained["nested"].append(3)
        snapshot = catalog.snapshot()
        snapshot["name"]["nested"][0] = 99
        snapshot["extra"] = True
        self.assertEqual(catalog.get("name"), {"nested": [1, 2]})
        self.assertEqual(catalog.snapshot(), {"name": {"nested": [1, 2]}})

    def test_put_replaces_only_named_entry(self):
        catalog = TemplateCatalog({"a": 1, "b": 2})
        catalog.put("a", {"replacement": True})
        self.assertEqual(catalog.snapshot(), {"a": {"replacement": True}, "b": 2})

    def test_missing_name_raises_key_error(self):
        catalog = TemplateCatalog()
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            catalog.get("missing")

    def test_initial_argument_validation(self):
        for bad in ([], (), "mapping", 1):
            with self.subTest(initial=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    TemplateCatalog(bad)
        for bad_key in (None, 1, True, ("x",)):
            with self.subTest(key=bad_key):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    TemplateCatalog({bad_key: "value"})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            TemplateCatalog({"": "value"})

    def test_name_validation_for_put_and_get(self):
        catalog = TemplateCatalog()
        for bad in (None, 1, True, ("x",)):
            with self.subTest(put_name=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    catalog.put(bad, 1)
            with self.subTest(get_name=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    catalog.get(bad)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            catalog.put("", 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            catalog.get("")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
